operating_notes.text: Domestic gross premium grew 7.56% to ₹32,979.23 Cr in FY26, 75% of total.
International combined ratio was 120.05% in FY26 versus 121.40% in FY25.
Life segment gross premium grew 31.27% to ₹2,450.48 Cr in FY26.
Domestic business contributed ₹32,979.23 Cr and international business contributed ₹11,027.51 Cr to FY26 gross premium.
Investment book was ₹157,800 Cr at market value at June 2026, split 73.4% fixed income, about 17% equity and about 8.67% money market.
Obligatory business was about 33% of the domestic book in Q1FY27, with the domestic combined ratio at 107.5.
GIC's losses from catastrophe events typically run at 30-40% of market losses, per management.

timeline.summary: GIC Re board approved an in-principle fund infusion of USD 49 million (₹469 crore) for solvency restoration into its Labuan branch on May 15, 2026.
General Insurance Corporation of India’s President (Promoter) declared no shares pledged or encumbered by 31 March 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹9,913.56 Cr, net profit ₹2,532.59 Cr.

General Insurance Corporation of India held an earnings call on June 1, 2026, discussing audited standalone and consolidated financial results for FY2026, with audio available at the company’s website.
GIC Re held its Q4 FY26 earnings call on June 1, 2026, reporting FY26 PAT of ₹8,392 Cr and a solvency ratio of 4.21.
On 17 August 2026 GIC's Q1FY27 call reported gross premium of ₹13,475.36 Cr, a combined ratio of 104.88% and solvency of 4.32, and set combined-ratio targets of 103 domestic and 95 foreign.
